1: #===============================================================================
2: # Data caches.
3: #===============================================================================
4: class Game_Temp
5:   attr_accessor :regional_dexes_data
6:   attr_accessor :battle_animations_data
7:   attr_accessor :move_to_battle_animation_data
8:   attr_accessor :map_infos
9: end

11: def pbClearData
12:   if $game_temp
13:     $game_temp.regional_dexes_data           = nil
14:     $game_temp.battle_animations_data        = nil
15:     $game_temp.move_to_battle_animation_data = nil
16:     $game_temp.map_infos                     = nil
17:   end
18:   MapFactoryHelper.clear
19:   $PokemonEncounters.setup($game_map.map_id) if $game_map && $PokemonEncounters
20:   if pbRgssExists?("Data/Tilesets.rxdata")
21:     $data_tilesets = load_data("Data/Tilesets.rxdata")
22:   end
23: end
24: 
25: #===============================================================================
26: # Method to get Regional Dexes data.
27: #===============================================================================
28: def pbLoadRegionalDexes
29:   $game_temp = Game_Temp.new if !$game_temp
30:   if !$game_temp.regional_dexes_data
31:     $game_temp.regional_dexes_data = load_data("Data/regional_dexes.dat")
32:   end
33:   return $game_temp.regional_dexes_data
34: end

36: #===============================================================================
37: # Methods relating to battle animations data.
38: #===============================================================================
39: def pbLoadBattleAnimations
40:   $game_temp = Game_Temp.new if !$game_temp
41:   if !$game_temp.battle_animations_data && pbRgssExists?("Data/PkmnAnimations.rxdata")
42:     $game_temp.battle_animations_data = load_data("Data/PkmnAnimations.rxdata")
43:   end
44:   return $game_temp.battle_animations_data
45: end

47: def pbLoadMoveToAnim
48:   $game_temp = Game_Temp.new if !$game_temp
49:   if !$game_temp.move_to_battle_animation_data
50:     $game_temp.move_to_battle_animation_data = load_data("Data/move2anim.dat") || []
51:   end
52:   return $game_temp.move_to_battle_animation_data
53: end

55: #===============================================================================
56: # Method relating to map infos data.
57: #===============================================================================
58: def pbLoadMapInfos
59:   $game_temp = Game_Temp.new if !$game_temp
60:   if !$game_temp.map_infos
61:     $game_temp.map_infos = load_data("Data/MapInfos.rxdata")
62:   end
